title: Law Second Pre Independence Law Commission 1853 Sir John Romilly
definition: The Second Law Commission of India was established under the Charter Act of 1853 to examine the recommendations of the First Law Commission and to suggest reforms in the judicial administration and legal procedures of British India.
importanceInUpsc: It represents a critical phase in the codification of Indian law, bridging the gap between the Macaulay-led First Commission and the eventual enactment of major codes like the IPC and CrPC.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Law Second Pre Independence Law Commission 1853 Sir John Romilly.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Evolution of British Judicial System in India
